newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins lower, unaffected by freeze review.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins lower, unaffected by freeze review.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were unaffected by news Russia's Prosecutor-General had ordered a review of all MinFin freezes and dealers said on Wednesday prices had eased in early trading from previous high levels.

Prosecutor-General Yuri Skuratov has ordered his staff to review all cases where MinFin bonds have been frozen by the authorities and if necessary to take measures to release them, Itar-Tass news agency quoted a senior Skuratov aide as saying.
The review, which has already started, is to be completed within a month, he said on Wednesday.
"Buying has not started yet. In principle, prices are around the levels they were at before the news about the freeze of MinFins for $57 million (in early November)," one dealer said.
Dealers said prices had eased earlier up to 0.5 point on profit-taking after active buying on Tuesday.
